info.name: Rapunzel
info.ability: Each night, choose a player. If Locked Away, remove it; otherwise they cannot die that night.

effects.prompt: Cada noche eliges a un jugador. Si está Encerrado, retiras su Encierro; si no, no puede morir esa noche.

info.name: El Padre del Jardín
info.ability: Once per game, move one active transferable token from another player to yourself.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida, mueves una ficha activa y transferible de otro jugador hacia ti.

info.name: La Madre del Antojo
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn whether any active token affects them.

info.name: Tower Rider
info.ability: Once per game at night, you may return a dead player to life.
info.lore: A prince from the Grimms' tales who recognizes a young woman cast aside by those around her and restores her to public life. In Snow White he receives the glass coffin and his {{team:grimm:siervo|plural}}' stumble frees the piece of apple; in Cinderella he keeps the golden slipper and rejects the false brides when he discovers their blood.

cues.body: The Tower Rider may return a dead player to life.
If unused, the Tower Rider may return a dead player to life.

info.name: El Mensajero de la Torre
info.ability: Each night, choose a Locked Away player: remove the lock until dawn, but they cannot vote or nominate the next day.

cues.body: Each night, choose a Locked Away player: remove the lock until dawn, but they cannot vote or nominate the next day.

effects.prompt: Cada noche eliges a un jugador Encerrado: retiras su Encierro hasta el amanecer, pero no puede votar ni nominar durante el día siguiente.

info.name: Tower Herbalist
info.ability: Once per game, when a player would die, they become Excluded until the next dawn instead.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida, cuando un jugador fuera a morir, en su lugar queda Excluido hasta el amanecer siguiente.

info.name: Apothecary
info.ability: Once per game, at night, choose another living player: they do not wake for their abilities that night, but their passive effects continue.

info.ability: Once per game, at night, choose two living players. At dawn, it becomes public which players were stitched. While both live, neither may nominate the other.
